title: GM ATF Pressure Port Adapter
lead: MOC has developed a new transmission adapter to be used on the GM 6L80 transmissions to bypass the thermostat for quicker service. This new adapter (Part No. 94796) connects to the pressure port by way of a short 90 degree adapter hose (Part No. 94898), given the tight space around the pressure port. An open hose adapter can be used and inserted into the transmission dipstick tube.
